VBO:0200843.summary: In a 1920 account, the Mahratta Greyhound was a hunting hound used by Indian chieftains to pursue leopard and wild pig, and was described as scarcer than the Rampur Hound. The regional type is also associated with Maharashtra in western India.
VBO:0200843.shortDescription: An Indian hunting hound associated with Maharashtra, used by chieftains to pursue leopard and wild pig.
